title: Are Large Language Models Really Bias-Free? Jailbreak Prompts for Assessing Adversarial Robustness to Bias Elicitation
reasoning: The paper explicitly identifies religion as one of the seven core bias categories used in its benchmarking methodology. It includes religion-specific prompts in its evaluation (Table 1) and reports individual safety scores for the 'Religion' category across multiple LLMs (Table 3).
